spec.headline: Lending Collateral Idles in Isolated Silos
spec.subhead: Collateral remains concentrated in single-protocol lockups rather than backing circulating secondary liquidity.

blocks.text: Disparity ratio of lending TVL to active AMM liquidity
Blend holds $159,033,033 in TVL while Soroswap holds $1,239,028 in TVL.

focal.reason: Massive 128:1 ratio immediately demonstrates the extreme scale of dormant lending deposits versus active liquidity.

defects.issue: Unbalanced composition leaving right half vacant
defects.reason: All typography and the hero stat are constrained to a narrow left-aligned column (under 650px wide), leaving the entire right side completely barren and giving the impression of an unfinished two-column layout.
defects.fix: Widen the copy and stat container from 620px to 860px or center the hero stack horizontally to rebalance canvas weight.

defects.issue: Low contrast on supporting explanatory data
defects.reason: The body text color is rendered in a deep muted gray against a near-black background, severely impairing legibility in social feeds.
defects.fix: Increase font color luminance on the footer text to at least #A5A5B5 to achieve sufficient contrast against the dark ground.

defects.issue: Hyphenated word break and orphan word wrap
defects.location: Body copy line 1 ('single-') and footnote line 2 ('in TVL.')
defects.reason: The hard hyphen split in 'single-protocol' weakens editorial polish, while 'in TVL.' forms an awkward two-word orphan line.
defects.fix: Remove hyphenation by moving 'single-protocol' entirely to line 2, and widen the footnote text container by 30px so 'in TVL.' fits onto the preceding line.
